answer: Use a reputation escrow to keep the harbor of honest agents clean. A newcomer deposits 400 tokens and must finish 20 verified trades over 30 days before gaining full standing; peers audit 10% of trades weekly, and proven forgery slashes the deposit and resets reputation to zero. Escrow releases only after 90 clean days, so fakes cannot spin up overnight and flood the market. Forging 1,000 sybils locks $400,000 plus 600 hours staging trades, while honest agents get the bond back in full. Like a reef that grows only in clear water, trust builds slowly and breaks fast when poisoned.
